local function isLocalPlayerShooting(Arguments, Method, Origin, OriginalDirection)
    local LocalChar = player.Character
    if not LocalChar then return false end

    local rayLength = OriginalDirection and OriginalDirection.Magnitude or 0

    if Origin and (Origin - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude <= 2 then
        if rayLength < 30 then
            return false
        end
    end

    local ignoreList = nil
    if Method == "Raycast" then
        local params = Arguments[4]
        if typeof(params) == "RaycastParams" then
            ignoreList = params.FilterDescendantsInstances
        end
    elseif Method == "FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList" then
        if typeof(Arguments[3]) == "table" then
            ignoreList = Arguments[3]
        end
    elseif Method == "FindPartOnRay" or Method == "findPartOnRay" then
        if typeof(Arguments[3]) == "table" then
            ignoreList = Arguments[3]
        elseif typeof(Arguments[4]) == "table" then
            ignoreList = Arguments[4]
        end
    end

    if ignoreList then
        for _, inst in next, ignoreList do
            if inst == LocalChar then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    if Origin and (Origin - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude <= 2 then
        return true
    end

    return false
end

local function tryGetOriginDirection(Method, Arguments)
    if Method == "FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList" or Method == "FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist"
        or Method == "FindPartOnRay" or Method == "findPartOnRay" then
        local A_Ray = Arguments[2]
        if typeof(A_Ray) == "Ray" then
            return A_Ray.Origin, A_Ray.Direction
        end
    elseif Method == "Raycast" then
        local A_Origin = Arguments[2]
        local A_Direction = Arguments[3]
        if typeof(A_Origin) == "Vector3" and typeof(A_Direction) == "Vector3" then
            return A_Origin, A_Direction
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

local oldNamecall
oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(...)
    local Method = getnamecallmethod()
    local Arguments = {...}
    local self = Arguments[1]

    if Method == "Play" and self.ClassName == "Sound" and not checkcaller() then
        local tool = self.Parent and self.Parent.Parent
        local localChar = player.Character
        if localChar and tool and tool.Parent == localChar and tool.ClassName == "Tool" and tool:GetAttribute("ToolType") == "Gun" then
            local soundClone = self:Clone()
            soundClone.Parent = camera
            soundClone.Playing = true
            task.delay(5, soundClone.Destroy, soundClone)
            return
        end
    end

    if shootRemote and self == shootRemote and Method == "FireServer" then
        local bulletData = Arguments[2]
        local firstPellet = type(bulletData) == "table" and bulletData[1] or nil
        local hitInstance = firstPellet and firstPellet[3] or nil

        task.defer(function()
            local success, validInstance = pcall(function()
                return hitInstance and typeof(hitInstance) == "Instance" and hitInstance.Parent and hitInstance.Name ~= "" and hitInstance
            end)

            if success and validInstance then
                registerHit(validInstance)
            end
        end)
    end

    if self == workspace and not checkcaller() then
        local Origin, Direction = tryGetOriginDirection(Method, Arguments)

        if Origin and Direction and isLocalPlayerShooting(Arguments, Method, Origin, Direction) then
            if Settings.Enabled and Settings.Method:lower() == Method:lower() and not AutoShootRaycastInProgress then
                local chance = CalculateChance(Settings.HitChance)
                if chance == true then
                    if Method == "FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList" and ValidateArguments(Arguments, ExpectedArguments.FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList) then
                        local NewDir = getRedirectedDirection(Origin, Direction)
                        if NewDir then Arguments[2] = Ray.new(Origin, NewDir) end
                    elseif Method == "FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist" and ValidateArguments(Arguments, ExpectedArguments.FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist) then
                        local NewDir = getRedirectedDirection(Origin, Direction)
                        if NewDir then Arguments[2] = Ray.new(Origin, NewDir) end
                    elseif (Method == "FindPartOnRay" or Method == "findPartOnRay") and ValidateArguments(Arguments, ExpectedArguments.FindPartOnRay) then
                        local NewDir = getRedirectedDirection(Origin, Direction)
                        if NewDir then Arguments[2] = Ray.new(Origin, NewDir) end
                    elseif Method == "Raycast" and ValidateArguments(Arguments, ExpectedArguments.Raycast) then
                        local NewDir = getRedirectedDirection(Origin, Direction)
                        if NewDir then Arguments[3] = NewDir end
                    end
                end
            end

            local rets = table.pack(oldNamecall(unpack(Arguments)))
            return table.unpack(rets, 1, rets.n)
        end
    end
    return oldNamecall(...)
end))

local InvisibleRealCFrame = nil
local InvisibleAnimationTrack = nil
local InvisibleRenderKey = "PrecisionInvisibleRender"
local InvisibleOriginalTransparency = {}
local InvisibleOriginalCanCollide = {}

local function loadInvisibleAnimation(character)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return nil end
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then return nil end
    local isR15 = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = isR15 and "rbxassetid://18665825805" or "rbxassetid://215384594"
    local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
    track:Play(0, 0.001, 0)
    animation:Destroy()
    task.delay(0, function()
        track.TimePosition = isR15 and 1.95 or 0.4
    end)
    return track
end

local function stopInvisible()
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(InvisibleRenderKey)
    end)
    if InvisibleAnimationTrack then
        InvisibleAnimationTrack:Stop()
        InvisibleAnimationTrack:Destroy()
        InvisibleAnimationTrack = nil
    end
    local character = player.Character
    local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if rootPart and InvisibleRealCFrame then
        rootPart.CFrame = InvisibleRealCFrame
        local currentVelocity = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(currentVelocity.X, 0, currentVelocity.Z)
    end
    InvisibleRealCFrame = nil

    if character then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= rootPart then
                if InvisibleOriginalTransparency[part] ~= nil then
                    part.Transparency = InvisibleOriginalTransparency[part]
                end
                if InvisibleOriginalCanCollide[part] ~= nil then
                    part.CanCollide = InvisibleOriginalCanCollide[part]
                end
            end
        end
        if rootPart then
            rootPart.Transparency = 1
        end
    end
    table.clear(InvisibleOriginalTransparency)
    table.clear(InvisibleOriginalCanCollide)
end

local function startInvisible()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then return end

    InvisibleAnimationTrack = loadInvisibleAnimation(character)
    InvisibleRealCFrame = nil

    table.clear(InvisibleOriginalTransparency)
    table.clear(InvisibleOriginalCanCollide)
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= rootPart then
            InvisibleOriginalTransparency[part] = part.Transparency
            InvisibleOriginalCanCollide[part] = part.CanCollide
            part.Transparency = 0.5
            part.CanCollide = false
        end

    rootPart.Transparency = 1

    end)

        if Settings.InvisibleEnabled and InvisibleRealCFrame and rootPart.Parent then
            rootPart.CFrame = InvisibleRealCFrame
            if InvisibleAnimationTrack then
                InvisibleAnimationTrack:AdjustWeight(0.001)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local hitboxModified = {}

    hrp.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
    hrp.Transparency = 1
    hrp.CanCollide = false
    hrp.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic

    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if isSeated then
        if hitboxModified[hrp] then
            resetHitbox(hrp)
            hitboxModified[hrp] = nil

        return

    hrp.CanCollide = false

local gettingWeapon = false
local OriginalGetWeaponsPosition = nil

local function getWeapon(ToolName)
    if gettingWeapon then return end
    gettingWeapon = true

    local Char = player.Character
    local Root = Char and Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not (Char and Root) then
        gettingWeapon = false
        return
    end

    if Char:FindFirstChild("ForceField") then
        gettingWeapon = false
        return
    end

    if player.Backpack:FindFirstChild(ToolName) or Char:FindFirstChild(ToolName) then
        gettingWeapon = false
        return
    end

    local Giver
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v.Name == "TouchGiver" and v:GetAttribute("ToolName") == ToolName then
            Giver = v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            break
        end
    end

    if not Giver then
        gettingWeapon = false
        return
    end

    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Get Weapons",
        Text = "Trying to get " .. ToolName .. "...",
        Duration = 3,
    })

    local OriginalGiverCFrame = Giver.CFrame
    local UndergroundCFrame = OriginalGiverCFrame - Vector3.new(0, 15.5, 0)

    Giver.CanTouch = true
    Giver.CFrame = UndergroundCFrame
    Root.Anchored = true
    Char:PivotTo(UndergroundCFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))

    task.wait(0.25)
    firetouchinterest(Giver, Root, 0)
    task.wait(0.3)
    firetouchinterest(Giver, Root, 1)

    if Giver and Giver.Parent then
        Giver.CFrame = OriginalGiverCFrame
    end

    local function HasWeapon()
        Char = player.Character
        return player.Backpack:FindFirstChild(ToolName) ~= nil or (Char and Char:FindFirstChild(ToolName) ~= nil)
    end

    local Obtained = false
    local Elapsed = 0
    while Elapsed < 3 do
        if HasWeapon() then
            Obtained = true
            break
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
        Elapsed = Elapsed + 0.1
    end

    if not Obtained then
        Elapsed = 0
        while Elapsed < 2.5 do
            if HasWeapon() then
                Obtained = true
                break
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
            Elapsed = Elapsed + 0.1
        end
    end

    if Obtained then
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Get Weapons",
            Text = "Successfully got " .. ToolName .. "!",
            Duration = 3,
        })
    else
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Get Weapons",
            Text = "Failed to get " .. ToolName .. ".",
            Duration = 3,
        })
    end

    Root.Anchored = false
    gettingWeapon = false
end

        if iterations > 20 then

    if model and model.Parent == carContainer then

    return nil

    local character = player.Character
    local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return false end

    local body = car:FindFirstChild("Body")
    local main = body and body:FindFirstChild("Main")
    if not main then return false end

    local vehicleSeat = car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
    if not vehicleSeat then return false end

    local targetPos = humanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    local curCF = main.CFrame
    local x, y, z = curCF:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos) * CFrame.Angles(x, y, z)

    local partData = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(partData, { part = v, wasAnchored = v.Anchored, wasCanCollide = v.CanCollide })
            v.Anchored = true
            v.CanCollide = false
        end
    end

    car.PrimaryPart = main

    local characterParts = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(characterParts, { part = v, wasCanCollide = v.CanCollide })
            v.CanCollide = false
        end
    end

    local success = false
    for attempt = 1, 20 do
        pcall(function() car:PivotTo(targetCFrame) end)
        task.wait()
        local distance = (main.Position - targetPos).Magnitude
        if distance < 5 then
            success = true
            break
        end
        if attempt % 5 == 0 then
            targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos + Vector3.new(math.random(-2, 2), 0, math.random(-2, 2))) * CFrame.Angles(x, y, z)
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        for attempt = 1, 20 do
            if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then break end
            pcall(function() character:PivotTo(vehicleSeat.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end)
            task.wait()
            local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp and (hrp.Position - vehicleSeat.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
                break
            end
        end
    end)

    task.wait(0.2)

    local restoreConnection
    restoreConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        restoreConnection:Disconnect()
        for _, data in ipairs(characterParts) do
            if data.part and data.part.Parent then
                data.part.CanCollide = data.wasCanCollide
            end
        end
        for _, data in ipairs(partData) do
            if data.part and data.part.Parent then
                data.part.Anchored = data.wasAnchored
                data.part.CanCollide = data.wasCanCollide
            end
        end
    end)

    return success
end

task.spawn(function()
    local MOVE_STEP = 1
    local TOL = 0.1
    local baseY, targetY, lastSlider = nil, nil, nil
    while true do
        task.wait()
        if not Settings.VehicleFlyEnabled then
            baseY, targetY, lastSlider = nil, nil, nil
            if workspace:FindFirstChild("CarPart") then
                workspace.CarPart:Destroy()
            end
            continue
        end

        local car = findLocalCar()
        if not car then
            if workspace:FindFirstChild("CarPart") then
                workspace.CarPart:Destroy()
            end
            baseY, targetY, lastSlider = nil, nil, nil
            continue
        end

        local main = car:FindFirstChild("Body") and car.Body:FindFirstChild("Main")
        if not main then continue end
        car.PrimaryPart = main
        local curCF = main.CFrame
        local curPos = curCF.Position
        local sliderVal = Settings.VehicleFlyHeight or 0

        if not workspace:FindFirstChild("CarPart") then
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Size = Vector3.new(100, 1, 100)
            p.Name = "CarPart"
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = true
            p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
            p.Transparency = 1
            p.Parent = workspace
        end

        if not baseY then
            baseY = curPos.Y
            targetY = baseY + sliderVal
            lastSlider = sliderVal
        elseif sliderVal ~= lastSlider then
            targetY = baseY + sliderVal
            lastSlider = sliderVal
        end

        if curPos.Y < targetY - TOL then
            local x, y, z = curCF:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
            local newY = math.min(curPos.Y + MOVE_STEP, targetY)
            car:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(curPos.X, newY, curPos.Z)) * CFrame.Angles(x, y, z))
        elseif curPos.Y > targetY + TOL then
            local x, y, z = curCF:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
            local newY = math.max(curPos.Y - MOVE_STEP, targetY)
            car:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(curPos.X, newY, curPos.Z)) * CFrame.Angles(x, y, z))
        end
    end
end)

local autoShootParams = RaycastParams.new()
autoShootParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
autoShootParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"

local lastAutoShotByWeapon = {}
local AutoShootRaycastInProgress = false

local function updateAmmoLabel(weapon, currentAmmo)
    local ok, gunFrame = pcall(function()
        return player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("Home", 3)
            :WaitForChild("hud", 3)
            :WaitForChild("BottomRightFrame", 3)
            :WaitForChild("GunFrame", 3)
    end)

    local behavior = weapon:GetAttribute("Behavior")
    if behavior == "Sniper" then
        local stored = weapon:GetAttribute("StoredAmmo") or 0
        bulletsLabel.Text = currentAmmo .. " | " .. stored
    else
        local maxAmmo = weapon:GetAttribute("MaxAmmo") or currentAmmo
        bulletsLabel.Text = currentAmmo .. "/" .. maxAmmo
    end
end

local function castPelletRay(weapon, origin, aimPoint, spreadRadius)
    local roll = math.random()
    local behavior = weapon:GetAttribute("Behavior")
    if behavior == "Sniper" or behavior == "Shotgun" then
        roll = math.sqrt(roll)
    end

    local range = weapon:GetAttribute("Range") or 1000
    local lookCFrame = CFrame.new(origin, aimPoint)
    local rollAngle = 360 - 720 * math.random()
    local direction = (lookCFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(rollAngle)) * CFrame.Angles(0, roll * spreadRadius, 0)).LookVector * range

    AutoShootRaycastInProgress = true
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, autoShootParams)
    AutoShootRaycastInProgress = false

    local hitInstance = result and result.Instance or nil
    local hitPosition = result and result.Position or (origin + direction)
    return hitInstance, hitPosition
end

local function performAutoShot(weapon)
    if not weapon or not shootRemote then return end
    if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then return end

    local behavior = weapon:GetAttribute("Behavior")
    local reloadSession = weapon:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0
    local currentAmmo = weapon:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 0

    if reloadSession ~= 0 then return end
    if currentAmmo <= 0 then return end

    local char = player.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end

    local origin = head.Position
    autoShootParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

    local aimPoint = currentTarget.Position
    local redirected = getRedirectedDirection(origin, aimPoint - origin)
    if redirected then
        aimPoint = origin + redirected
    end

    local projectileCount = weapon:GetAttribute("ProjectileCount") or 1
    local spreadRadius = weapon:GetAttribute("SpreadRadius") or 0

    local muzzle = weapon:FindFirstChild("Muzzle")
    local muzzlePos = muzzle and muzzle.Position or origin

    local bulletData = {}

    for i = 1, projectileCount do
        local hitInstance, hitPosition = castPelletRay(weapon, origin, aimPoint, spreadRadius)
        table.insert(bulletData, { origin, hitPosition, hitInstance })

        if AutoShootGunTracers then
            pcall(function()
                if behavior == "Sniper" then
                    AutoShootGunTracers.createSniper(muzzlePos, hitPosition)
                elseif behavior == "Taser" then
                    AutoShootGunTracers.createTaser(muzzlePos, hitPosition)
                else
                    AutoShootGunTracers.createBullet(muzzlePos, hitPosition)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    shootRemote:FireServer(bulletData)

    local newAmmo = currentAmmo - 1
    weapon:SetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo", newAmmo)
    updateAmmoLabel(weapon, newAmmo)

    pcall(function()
        local handle = weapon:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if handle then
            local shootSound = handle:FindFirstChild("ShootSound")
            if shootSound then
                local cloned = shootSound:Clone()
                cloned.Parent = handle
                cloned:Play()
                game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(cloned, 5)
            end

            local flare = handle:FindFirstChild("Flare")
            if flare then
                flare.Enabled = true
                task.delay(0.05, function()
                    if flare then
                        flare.Enabled = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not shootRemote then return end
    if not Settings.Enabled or not Settings.Autoshoot then return end
    if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then return end

    local char = player.Character
    local myHumanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not myHumanoid or myHumanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

    if not weapon then return end

    local fireRate = weapon:GetAttribute("FireRate") or 0.1
    local weaponAutoFireAttr = weapon:GetAttribute("AutoFire")
    if not weaponAutoFireAttr then
        fireRate = fireRate * 1.5
    end

    if weapon.Name == "Remington 870" then
        fireRate = 0.45  
    end

    local lastShotTime = lastAutoShotByWeapon[weapon.Name] or 0
    if (tick() - lastShotTime) < fireRate then return end
    lastAutoShotByWeapon[weapon.Name] = tick()

    performAutoShot(weapon)
end)

local gunModNames = {"AK-47", "Remington 870", "M9", "M700", "M4A1", "FAL", "MP5", "Revolver"}

local function applyGunMod(tool)
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
    if not table.find(gunModNames, tool.Name) then return end
    if not Settings.GunModEnabled then return end

    tool:SetAttribute("AutoFire", Settings.AutoFire == true)

    if Settings.FastFirerateEnabled then
        local rate = Settings.FireRateValue or 0.01
        tool:SetAttribute("FireRate", rate)

        if ToolPropertiesFolder then
            pcall(function()
                local moduleScript = ToolPropertiesFolder:FindFirstChild(tool.Name)
                if moduleScript then
                    local props = require(moduleScript)
                    props.FireRate = rate
                    props.AutoFire = Settings.AutoFire == true
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function applyGunModToAllTools()
    local char = player.Character
    if char then
        for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            applyGunMod(tool)
        end
    end

    local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if backpack then
        for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            applyGunMod(tool)
        end
    end
end

    if not weapon or not FuncReloadRemote then return end
    if autoReloadInProgress[weapon] then return end

    local currentReloadSession = weapon:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0
    if currentReloadSession ~= 0 then return end

    local behavior = weapon:GetAttribute("Behavior")
    local storedAmmo = weapon:GetAttribute("StoredAmmo")

    if behavior == "Sniper" and storedAmmo and storedAmmo <= 0 then
        return
    end

    autoReloadInProgress[weapon] = true

    local reloadTime = weapon:GetAttribute("ReloadTime") or 1
    local session = tick()
    weapon:SetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession", session)

    task.spawn(function()
        FuncReloadRemote:InvokeServer()
    end)

    task.delay(reloadTime, function()
        if weapon:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") == session then
            if behavior == "Sniper" then
                local currentAmmo = weapon:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 0
                local maxAmmo = weapon:GetAttribute("MaxAmmo") or 1
                local stored = weapon:GetAttribute("StoredAmmo") or 0

                if currentAmmo < maxAmmo then
                    weapon:SetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo", 1)
                    updateAmmoLabel(weapon, 1)
                end
            else
                local maxAmmo = weapon:GetAttribute("MaxAmmo") or 0
                weapon:SetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo", maxAmmo)
                updateAmmoLabel(weapon, maxAmmo)
            end
            weapon:SetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession", 0)
        end
        autoReloadInProgress[weapon] = nil
    end)
end

local function storeOriginalProps(tool)
    for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and not table.find(excludedPartNames, part.Name) and not originalPartProps[part] then
            originalPartProps[part] = {
                Color = part.Color,
                Material = part.Material,
                Transparency = part.Transparency,
                TextureID = part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.TextureID or nil,
            }
        end
    end
end

local function applyWeaponSkin(tool)
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
    if not table.find(skinToolNames, tool.Name) then return end

    storeOriginalProps(tool)

    for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and not table.find(excludedPartNames, part.Name) then
            if SkinSettings.Enabled then
                part.Color = SkinSettings.Color
                part.Material = SkinSettings.Material
                part.Transparency = SkinSettings.Transparency
            else
                local orig = originalPartProps[part]
                if orig then
                    part.Color = orig.Color
                    part.Material = orig.Material
                    part.Transparency = orig.Transparency
                end
            end

            if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
                if SkinSettings.TextureEnabled and SkinSettings.TextureId ~= "" then
                    part.TextureID = SkinSettings.TextureId
                else
                    local orig = originalPartProps[part]
                    if orig and orig.TextureID then
                        part.TextureID = orig.TextureID
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

    local char = player.Character

function applyESP(plr)
    if plr == player then return end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    local teamColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    if plr.TeamColor then teamColor = plr.TeamColor.Color
    elseif plr.Team and plr.Team.TeamColor then teamColor = plr.Team.TeamColor.Color end
    
    local highlight = char:FindFirstChild("ESPHighlight")
    if not highlight then
        highlight = Instance.new("Highlight", char)
        highlight.Name = "ESPHighlight"

    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.85
    highlight.OutlineColor = teamColor
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0

        local head = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

            local targetBillboard = head:FindFirstChild("ESPTargetNameTag")

local function loadUI()
    local uiUrls = {
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ludicious-claw/precisionlol/refs/heads/main/UI%20Test",
        "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ludicious-claw/precisionlol@main/UI%20Test",
    }

    local maxAttempts = 3
    local retryDelay = 1.5

    for _, url in ipairs(uiUrls) do
        for attempt = 1, maxAttempts do
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                local source = game:HttpGet(url)

                if not source or #source < 100 or source:sub(1, 1) == "<" then
                    error("Invalid or empty response from URL")
                end

                local chunk, compileErr = loadstring(source)
                if not chunk then
                    error("Failed to compile UI: " .. tostring(compileErr))
                end

                return chunk()
            end)

            if ok then
                return true
            end

            task.wait(retryDelay)
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function fetchThumbnail(userId, kind, size)
    local ok, res = pcall(http_request, {
        Url = ("https://thumbnails.roblox.com/v1/users/%s?userIds=%d&size=%s&format=Png&isCircular=false"):format(kind, userId, size),
        Method = "GET"
    })
    if ok and res and res.StatusCode == 200 then
        local dok, decoded = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body)
        if dok and decoded and decoded.data and decoded.data[1] then
            return decoded.data[1].imageUrl
        end
    end
    return ("https://www.roblox.com/headshot-thumbnail/image?userId=%d&width=420&height=420&format=png"):format(userId)
end

local function SafeSet(obj, prop, val)

    local ok = pcall(function()

    end)

end

    if obj then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  ROLE DETECTION
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function DetectRole(player)
    if not player or not player.Parent then return "Unknown" end

    local team = player.Team
    if team then
        local name = string.lower(team.Name)
        if name:find("guard") or name:find("police") or name:find("cop") or name:find("officer") then
            return "Guard"
        elseif name:find("inmate") or name:find("prisoner") then
            return "Inmate"
        elseif name:find("criminal") or name:find("escapee") or name:find("wanted") then
            return "Criminal"
        elseif name:find("neutral") or name:find("civilian") then
            return "Neutral"
        end

        local ok, color = pcall(function() return team.TeamColor.Color end)
        if ok and color then
            local r, g, b = color.R, color.G, color.B
            if b > 0.6 and r < 0.4 and g < 0.6 then
                return "Guard"
            elseif r > 0.7 and g > 0.4 and g < 0.8 and b < 0.4 then
                return "Inmate"
            elseif r > 0.7 and g < 0.4 and b < 0.4 then
                return "Criminal"
            elseif r > 0.6 and g > 0.6 and b > 0.6 then
                return "Neutral"
            end
        end
    end

    return "Unknown"
end

local function IsLocalGuard()
    local role = DetectRole(LocalPlayer)
    return role == "Guard"
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  HEALTH HELPERS
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function GetHealth(player)
    if not player then return 0, 100 end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return 0, 100 end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        return hum.Health, hum.MaxHealth
    end
    return 0, 100
end

local function GetHealthColor(health, maxHealth)
    if not maxHealth or maxHealth <= 0 then return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) end
    local percent = math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1)

    if percent >= 0.75 then
        return Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 100)
    elseif percent >= 0.50 then
        return Color3.fromRGB(180, 220, 70)
    elseif percent >= 0.25 then
        return Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 50)
    else
        return Color3.fromRGB(230, 60, 60)
    end
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  PLAYER CACHE & CHAR CACHE
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local cachedPlayersList = Players:GetPlayers()
local function GetPlayersCache() return cachedPlayersList end
local function UpdatePlayerCache() cachedPlayersList = Players:GetPlayers() end

local CharCache = {}

local function GetCharacter(player)
    if not player then return nil end

    local cache = CharCache[player]
    if cache then
        local char = cache.Char
        local root = cache.Root
        if char and char.Parent and char == player.Character and root and root.Parent then
            if cache.Humanoid then
                if cache.Humanoid.Health > 0 then return char, root end
                return nil
            end
            return char, root
        else
            cache.Char = nil
            cache.Root = nil
            cache.Humanoid = nil
        end
    end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character.Parent then return nil end

    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
    if not rootPart then return nil end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end

    if not cache then
        cache = {}
        CharCache[player] = cache
    end
    cache.Char = character
    cache.Root = rootPart
    cache.Humanoid = humanoid
    cache.Head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

    return character, rootPart
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  HUMANOID STATE (capture only — never force defaults)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local HumanoidState = { Original = {}, Captured = false }

local HUMANOID_PROPERTY_MAP = {
    ["Humanoid/WalkSpeed"]  = "WalkSpeed",
    ["Humanoid/JumpPower"]  = "JumpPower",
    ["Humanoid/JumpHeight"] = "JumpHeight",
    ["Humanoid/HipHeight"]  = "HipHeight",
    ["Humanoid/MaxHealth"]  = "MaxHealth",
}

local function CaptureHumanoidSettings()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    HumanoidState.Original = {}

    for flagKey, prop in pairs(HUMANOID_PROPERTY_MAP) do
        local ok, val = pcall(function() return hum[prop] end)
        if ok and val ~= nil then
            HumanoidState.Original[flagKey] = val

            local isLocked = Flags[flagKey .. "/Locked"] == true
            if not isLocked and Flags[flagKey] == nil then
                Flags[flagKey] = val
            end
        end
    end

    HumanoidState.Captured = true
end

local function ApplySavedHumanoidSettings()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    for flagKey, prop in pairs(HUMANOID_PROPERTY_MAP) do
        local val = Flags[flagKey]
        local isLocked = Flags[flagKey .. "/Locked"] == true
        local origVal = HumanoidState.Original[flagKey]

        if isLocked or (val ~= nil and origVal ~= nil and val ~= origVal) then
            pcall(function()
                if hum[prop] ~= val then
                    hum[prop] = val
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function ApplyHumanoidSettings()
    if not HumanoidState.Captured then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    for flagKey, prop in pairs(HUMANOID_PROPERTY_MAP) do
        local isLocked = Flags[flagKey .. "/Locked"] == true
        if isLocked then
            local val = Flags[flagKey]
            if val ~= nil then
                pcall(function()
                    if hum[prop] ~= val then
                        hum[prop] = val
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  AIM SYSTEM
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local TARGET_GROUPS = {
    Head = {"Head"},
    Torso = {"Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "HumanoidRootPart"},
    LeftArm = {"Left Arm", "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand"},
    RightArm = {"Right Arm", "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand"},
    LeftLeg = {"Left Leg", "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot"},
    RightLeg = {"Right Leg", "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"},
}

local ALL_BODY_PARTS = {}
for _, group in pairs(TARGET_GROUPS) do
    for _, part in ipairs(group) do
        table.insert(ALL_BODY_PARTS, part)
    end
end

local AimState = {
    LastAimTarget = nil,
    LastMouseMode = nil,
    LastOriginX = nil,
    LastOriginY = nil,
}

local function ClearAimLockState(resetMouseMode)
    AimState.LastAimTarget = nil
    AimState.LastOriginX = nil
    AimState.LastOriginY = nil
    if resetMouseMode then
        AimState.LastMouseMode = nil
    end
end

local CachedFilterType = (function()
    local ok, val = pcall(function()
        local ft = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        if typeof(ft) == "EnumItem" then return ft end
    end)
    if ok and val then return val end
    ok, val = pcall(function()
        local ft = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
        if typeof(ft) == "EnumItem" then return ft end
    end)
    if ok and val then return val end
    return nil
end)()

local SharedRaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
SharedRaycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
if CachedFilterType then
    SharedRaycastParams.FilterType = CachedFilterType
end

local function Raycast(Origin, Direction, Filter)
    SharedRaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Filter
    return Workspace:Raycast(Origin, Direction, SharedRaycastParams)
end

local OcclusionFilter = {nil, nil}

local function ObjectOccluded(Enabled, Origin, Position, Object)
    if not Enabled then return false end
    if typeof(Position) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    OcclusionFilter[1] = LocalPlayer.Character
    OcclusionFilter[2] = Object
    local hit = Raycast(Origin, Position - Origin, OcclusionFilter)
    if hit and hit.Instance and not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(Object) then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local ViewportCache = {}
local ViewportPool = {}
local MAX_VIEWPORT_POOL = 64
local _vp_floor = math.floor

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local recycled = 0
    for _, entry in pairs(ViewportCache) do
        if recycled < MAX_VIEWPORT_POOL then
            ViewportPool[#ViewportPool + 1] = entry
            recycled = recycled + 1
        end
    end
    table.clear(ViewportCache)
end)

local function GetViewportPoint(worldPos)
    local kx = _vp_floor(worldPos.X * 4)
    local ky = _vp_floor(worldPos.Y * 4)
    local kz = _vp_floor(worldPos.Z * 4)
    local key = kx .. "|" .. ky .. "|" .. kz
    local entry = ViewportCache[key]
    if entry then return entry[1], entry[2] end

    local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
    entry = table.remove(ViewportPool) or {}
    entry[1], entry[2] = screenPos, onScreen
    ViewportCache[key] = entry
    return screenPos, onScreen
end

local function GetCrosshairViewportPosition(mouseBehavior)
    if not Camera then Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera end
    if not Camera then return nil, nil, false end

    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize

    if mouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
        return viewportSize.X * 0.5, viewportSize.Y * 0.5, true
    end

    local mouseLoc = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local crosshairX = mouseLoc.X
    local crosshairY = mouseLoc.Y

    if crosshairX ~= crosshairX or crosshairY ~= crosshairY then
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    if crosshairX < 0 or crosshairY < 0
    or crosshairX > viewportSize.X or crosshairY > viewportSize.Y then
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    return crosshairX, crosshairY, true
end

local CandidateList = {}
local CandidateCount = 0
local MAX_CANDIDATES = 15
local ClosestResult = {nil, nil, nil, 0, 0, nil}

local function CandidateSortFn(a, b)
    return a.mag < b.mag
end

local function BoundedInsertionSort(array, count, compare)
    for i = 2, count do
        local key = array[i]
        local j = i - 1
        while j > 0 and compare(key, array[j]) do
            array[j + 1] = array[j]
            j = j - 1
        end
        array[j + 1] = key
    end
end

local _hoistedCheckParts = {}
local _lastTargetGroupsHash = nil

local function RebuildCheckParts()
    table.clear(_hoistedCheckParts)
    local anySelected = false
    for category, enabled in pairs(Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"]) do
        if enabled then
            anySelected = true
            for _, partName in ipairs(TARGET_GROUPS[category]) do
                table.insert(_hoistedCheckParts, partName)
            end
        end
    end
    if not anySelected then
        for _, partName in ipairs(ALL_BODY_PARTS) do
            table.insert(_hoistedCheckParts, partName)
        end
    end
end

local function GetClosest(Enabled, TeamCheck, VisibilityCheck, FieldOfView, StickyTarget)
    if not Enabled then return nil end

    local CameraPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local mouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior

    local crosshairX, crosshairY, crosshairValid = GetCrosshairViewportPosition(mouseBehavior)
    if not crosshairValid then return nil end

    CandidateCount = 0

    local players = GetPlayersCache()
    local lookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local maxCandsLimit = MAX_CANDIDATES * 3

    local currentHash =
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].Head and 1 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].Torso and 2 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].LeftArm and 4 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].RightArm and 8 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].LeftLeg and 16 or 0) +
        (Flags["Aim/TargetGroups"].RightLeg and 32 or 0)
    if currentHash ~= _lastTargetGroupsHash then
        RebuildCheckParts()
        _lastTargetGroupsHash = currentHash
    end
    local checkParts = _hoistedCheckParts

    for _, Player in ipairs(players) do
        if Player == LocalPlayer then continue end

        local Character, RootPart = GetCharacter(Player)
        if not Character or not RootPart then continue end

        if TeamCheck then
            local lpTeam, pTeam = LocalPlayer.Team, Player.Team
            if lpTeam and pTeam and lpTeam == pTeam then continue end
        end

        local rootPos = RootPart.Position
        local relPos = rootPos - CameraPosition
        if lookVector:Dot(relPos) < 0 then continue end

        for _, PartName in ipairs(checkParts) do
            local cache = CharCache[Player]
            local BodyPart = (cache and cache[PartName]) or Character:FindFirstChild(PartName)
            if not BodyPart then continue end

            local ActualPosition = BodyPart.Position

            local ScreenPosition, OnScreen = GetViewportPoint(ActualPosition)
            if OnScreen then
                local screenX, screenY = ScreenPosition.X, ScreenPosition.Y
                local dx, dy = screenX - crosshairX, screenY - crosshairY
                local Magnitude = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

                if Magnitude < FieldOfView then
                    if CandidateCount < maxCandsLimit then
                        CandidateCount = CandidateCount + 1
                        local entry = CandidateList[CandidateCount]
                        if not entry then
                            entry = {}
                            CandidateList[CandidateCount] = entry
                        end
                        entry.mag = Magnitude
                        entry.ply = Player
                        entry.char = Character
                        entry.part = BodyPart
                        entry.sx = screenX
                        entry.sy = screenY
                        entry.pos = ActualPosition
                        entry.realPos = ActualPosition
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if CandidateCount == 0 then return nil end

    if CandidateCount > 1 then
        BoundedInsertionSort(CandidateList, CandidateCount, CandidateSortFn)
    end

    if StickyTarget then
        for i = 1, CandidateCount do
            local entry = CandidateList[i]
            if entry.ply == StickyTarget then
                if not ObjectOccluded(VisibilityCheck, CameraPosition, entry.realPos, entry.char) then
                    ClosestResult[1] = entry.ply
                    ClosestResult[2] = entry.char
                    ClosestResult[3] = entry.part
                    ClosestResult[4] = entry.sx
                    ClosestResult[5] = entry.sy
                    ClosestResult[6] = entry.pos
                    return ClosestResult
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end

    local limit = math.min(CandidateCount, MAX_CANDIDATES)

    for i = 1, limit do
        local entry = CandidateList[i]
        if not entry then continue end

        if ObjectOccluded(VisibilityCheck, CameraPosition, entry.realPos, entry.char) then
            continue
        end

        ClosestResult[1] = entry.ply
        ClosestResult[2] = entry.char
        ClosestResult[3] = entry.part
        ClosestResult[4] = entry.sx
        ClosestResult[5] = entry.sy
        ClosestResult[6] = entry.pos
        return ClosestResult
    end

    return nil
end

local function AimAt(Hitbox)
    if not Hitbox then
        ClearAimLockState(false)
        return
    end
    if not mousemoverel then return end

    local targetPart = Hitbox[3]
    if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then
        ClearAimLockState(false)
        return
    end

    local currentMode = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
    if currentMode ~= AimState.LastMouseMode then
        AimState.LastMouseMode = currentMode
        AimState.LastOriginX = nil
        AimState.LastOriginY = nil
    end

    local currentTarget = Hitbox[1]
    if currentTarget ~= AimState.LastAimTarget then
        AimState.LastAimTarget = currentTarget
        AimState.LastOriginX = nil
        AimState.LastOriginY = nil
    end

    local targetPos = targetPart.Position
    local cameraPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local dist = (targetPos - cameraPos).Magnitude

    if dist < 1 then return end

    local ScreenPosition, OnScreen = GetViewportPoint(targetPos)
    if not OnScreen or ScreenPosition.Z <= 0 then return end

    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
    local originX, originY, originValid = GetCrosshairViewportPosition(currentMode)
    if not originValid then return end

    AimState.LastOriginX = originX
    AimState.LastOriginY = originY

    local targetX, targetY = ScreenPosition.X, ScreenPosition.Y
    local dx, dy = targetX - originX, targetY - originY

    local mag = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    if mag > Flags["Aim/FOV/Radius"] then return end

    local attractionMultiplier = Flags["Aim/AttractionStrength"] / 100

    if Flags["Aim/Dampening"] then
        local lockThreshold = Flags["Aim/Dampening/Threshold"]
        if mag < lockThreshold then
            local dampening = math.max(Flags["Aim/Dampening/Strength"] / 100, mag / lockThreshold)
            attractionMultiplier = attractionMultiplier * dampening
        end
    end

    local BASE_PULL = 0.2
    local deltaX = dx * BASE_PULL * attractionMultiplier
    local deltaY = dy * BASE_PULL * attractionMultiplier

    if deltaX ~= deltaX or deltaY ~= deltaY then return end

    local maxClampX = viewportSize.X * 0.5
    local maxClampY = viewportSize.Y * 0.5

    deltaX = math.clamp(deltaX, -maxClampX, maxClampX)
    deltaY = math.clamp(deltaY, -maxClampY, maxClampY)

    mousemoverel(math.floor(deltaX + 0.5), math.floor(deltaY + 0.5))
end

local CachedTarget = nil
local CachedTargetTime = 0
local TARGET_CACHE_DURATION = 0.016

local function GetCachedTarget()
    local now = os.clock()
    if CachedTarget and (now - CachedTargetTime) < TARGET_CACHE_DURATION then
        return CachedTarget
    end

    CachedTarget = GetClosest(
        true,
        Flags["Aim/TeamCheck"],
        Flags["Aim/VisibilityCheck"],
        Flags["Aim/FOV/Radius"],
        AimState.LastAimTarget
    )
    CachedTargetTime = now
    return CachedTarget
end

        return
    end

        stroke.Thickness = 1.5
        stroke.Color = THEME.Accent
        stroke.Transparency = 0.2
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = FovCircleFrame

        FovCircleFrame.Parent = gui
    end

    local currentMode = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
    local crosshairX, crosshairY, crosshairValid = GetCrosshairViewportPosition(currentMode)

        local diameter = radius * 2
        FovCircleFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter)

local function UpdateAim()
    pcall(UpdateFOVCircle)

    if SAFE_MODE then return end

    local AimActive = Flags["Aim/AimLock"]
    if not AimActive then
        ClearAimLockState(false)
        return
    end

    local target = GetCachedTarget()
    if target then
        AimAt(target)
    else
        ClearAimLockState(false)
    end
end

local function UpdateNametag(player)
    local data = ESP.Objects[player]
    if not data then return end

    local shouldShow = Flags["ESP/Enabled"]
    if shouldShow and Flags["ESP/TeamCheck"] then
        if player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            shouldShow = false
        end
    end
    if shouldShow and player == LocalPlayer then shouldShow = false end

    local char = player.Character
    local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart)
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then shouldShow = false end

    local dist = 0
    if shouldShow then
        local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character
            and (LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart)
        if myRoot then
            dist = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist > Flags["ESP/MaxDistance"] then shouldShow = false end
        end
    end

    if not shouldShow then
        SafeSet(data.Nametag, "Enabled", false)
        if data.Highlight then SafeSet(data.Highlight, "Enabled", false) end
        return
    end

    if data.Nametag.Adornee ~= root then data.Nametag.Adornee = root end
    SafeSet(data.Nametag, "Enabled", true)
    SafeSet(data.Nametag, "MaxDistance", Flags["ESP/MaxDistance"])

    if data.Highlight then
        local hlActive = Flags["ESP/HighlightEnabled"]
        if data.Highlight.Adornee ~= char then data.Highlight.Adornee = char end
        SafeSet(data.Highlight, "Enabled", hlActive)
    end

    if Flags["ESP/ShowUsername"] then
        if data.LastName ~= player.Name then
            data.LastName = player.Name
            SafeSet(data.Label, "Text", player.Name)
        end
        SafeSet(data.Label, "Visible", true)
    else
        SafeSet(data.Label, "Visible", false)
    end

    local health, maxHealth = GetHealth(player)
    if data.HealthNum then
        SafeSet(data.HealthNum, "Visible", Flags["ESP/HealthIndicator"])
        if data.LastHealth ~= math.floor(health) or data.LastMaxHealth ~= math.floor(maxHealth) then
            data.LastHealth = math.floor(health)
            data.LastMaxHealth = math.floor(maxHealth)
            SafeSet(data.HealthNum, "Text", string.format("%d / %d", math.floor(health), math.floor(maxHealth)))
            local hpColor = GetHealthColor(health, maxHealth)
            SafeSet(data.HealthNum, "TextColor3", hpColor)
            if data.HealthBarFill then
                local pct = math.clamp(health / math.max(maxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                SafeSet(data.HealthBarFill, "Size", UDim2.fromScale(pct, 1))
                SafeSet(data.HealthBarFill, "BackgroundColor3", hpColor)
            end
        end
    end
    if data.HealthBarBG then
        SafeSet(data.HealthBarBG, "Visible", Flags["ESP/HealthIndicator"])
    end

    if data.DistanceLabel then
        SafeSet(data.DistanceLabel, "Visible", Flags["ESP/ShowDistance"])
        local distRounded = math.floor(dist)
        if math.abs(data.LastDistance - distRounded) >= 1 then
            data.LastDistance = distRounded
            SafeSet(data.DistanceLabel, "Text", string.format("%d studs", distRounded))
        end
    end

    if data.EquippedLabel then
        SafeSet(data.EquippedLabel, "Visible", Flags["ESP/ShowEquipped"])
        local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        local toolName = tool and tool.Name or "Unarmed"
        local equippedStr = "[" .. toolName .. "]"
        if data.LastEquipped ~= equippedStr then
            data.LastEquipped = equippedStr
            SafeSet(data.EquippedLabel, "Text", equippedStr)
        end
    end

    local role = Flags["ESP/ColorByRole"] and DetectRole(player) or nil
    if role then
        if data.LastRole ~= role then
            data.LastRole = role
            local color = ROLE_COLORS[role] or ROLE_COLORS.Unknown
            SafeSet(data.Label, "TextColor3", color)
            if data.Highlight then
                SafeSet(data.Highlight, "FillColor", color)
                SafeSet(data.Highlight, "OutlineColor", color)
            end
        end
    else
        if data.LastRole ~= "plain" then
            data.LastRole = "plain"
            SafeSet(data.Label, "TextColor3", ROLE_COLORS.Neutral)
            if data.Highlight then
                SafeSet(data.Highlight, "FillColor", ROLE_COLORS.Neutral)
                SafeSet(data.Highlight, "OutlineColor", ROLE_COLORS.Neutral)
            end
        end
    end

    local op = Flags["ESP/NametagOpacity"]
    SafeSet(data.Label, "TextTransparency", op)
    if data.HealthNum then SafeSet(data.HealthNum, "TextTransparency", op) end
    if data.DistanceLabel then SafeSet(data.DistanceLabel, "TextTransparency", op) end
    if data.EquippedLabel then SafeSet(data.EquippedLabel, "TextTransparency", op) end
    if data.HealthBarBG then SafeSet(data.HealthBarBG, "BackgroundTransparency", op) end
    if data.HealthBarFill then SafeSet(data.HealthBarFill, "BackgroundTransparency", op) end
end

local function RefreshESP()
    local players = Players:GetPlayers()
    for _, p in ipairs(players) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            if not ESP.Objects[p] then CreateNametag(p) end
            UpdateNametag(p)
        end
    end
    for p, _ in pairs(ESP.Objects) do
        if not p.Parent then RemoveNametag(p) end
    end
end

--  NOCLIP
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local Noclip = {
    Broken = {},
    BrokenCount = 0,
    OverlapParams = OverlapParams.new(),
    RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new(),
    ScratchIgnore = {},
}

Noclip.OverlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
Noclip.OverlapParams.MaxParts = 0
Noclip.RaycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
Noclip.RaycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

local _feetPartsBuffer = {}

local function GetPartsUnderFeet(char)
    table.clear(_feetPartsBuffer)
    if not char then return _feetPartsBuffer end

    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return _feetPartsBuffer end

    local ignore = Noclip.ScratchIgnore
    table.clear(ignore)
    ignore[1] = char
    Noclip.RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

    local basePos = root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    local direction = Vector3.new(0, -12, 0)
    local rootCF = root.CFrame

    local relOffsets = {
        Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
        Vector3.new(-1.2, 0, -1.2), Vector3.new(1.2, 0, -1.2),
        Vector3.new(-1.2, 0, 1.2),  Vector3.new(1.2, 0, 1.2),
    }

    for _, relOff in ipairs(relOffsets) do
        local origin = basePos + rootCF:VectorToWorldSpace(relOff)
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, Noclip.RaycastParams)
        end)
        if ok and result and result.Instance then
            _feetPartsBuffer[result.Instance] = true
        end
    end

    return _feetPartsBuffer
end

local function ShouldBreak(part, feetParts)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    if part:IsA("Terrain") then return false end
    if not part.Parent then return false end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if myChar and part:IsDescendantOf(myChar) then return false end

    local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return false end

    if part:IsA("SpawnLocation") then return false end

    if feetParts and feetParts[part] then return false end

    local name = string.lower(part.Name)
    if name == "baseplate" or name == "ground" or name == "floor"
    or name == "terrain" or name == "base" then
        return false
    end

    if part.Size.X > 400 and part.Size.Z > 400 then return false end

    if part.Anchored then
        if not Flags["Noclip/IncludeAnchored"] then return false end
    else
        if not Flags["Noclip/IncludeUnanchored"] then return false end
    end

    return true
end

local function BreakPart(part)
    if Noclip.Broken[part] then
        if part.CanCollide then
            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
        end
        return
    end

    Noclip.Broken[part] = { cc = part.CanCollide }
    Noclip.BrokenCount = Noclip.BrokenCount + 1
    pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
end

local function RestorePart(part)
    local data = Noclip.Broken[part]
    if not data then return end
    pcall(function()
        if part and part.Parent and type(data) == "table" then
            part.CanCollide = data.cc
        end
    end)
    Noclip.Broken[part] = nil
    Noclip.BrokenCount = math.max(0, Noclip.BrokenCount - 1)
end

local function RestoreAll()
    for part, data in pairs(Noclip.Broken) do
        pcall(function()
            if part and part.Parent and type(data) == "table" then
                part.CanCollide = data.cc
            end
        end)
    end
    Noclip.Broken = {}
    Noclip.BrokenCount = 0
end

local function ScanAndBreak()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return end

    local radius = Flags["Noclip/Radius"] or 300
    local origin = root.Position

    local feetParts = GetPartsUnderFeet(char)

    local ignore = Noclip.ScratchIgnore
    table.clear(ignore)
    ignore[1] = char
    Noclip.OverlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

    local ok, parts = pcall(function()
        return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(origin, radius, Noclip.OverlapParams)
    end)
    if not ok or not parts then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if ShouldBreak(part, feetParts) then
            BreakPart(part)
        end
    end
end

local function EnforceNoclip()
    if next(Noclip.Broken) == nil then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return end

    local feetParts = GetPartsUnderFeet(char)

    local toRemove = nil
    local toRestore = nil

    for part, _ in pairs(Noclip.Broken) do
        if not part or not part.Parent then
            toRemove = toRemove or {}
            toRemove[#toRemove + 1] = part
        elseif feetParts[part] then
            toRestore = toRestore or {}
            toRestore[#toRestore + 1] = part
        elseif part.CanCollide then
            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
        end
    end

    if toRemove then
        for _, part in ipairs(toRemove) do
            if Noclip.Broken[part] then
                Noclip.Broken[part] = nil
                Noclip.BrokenCount = math.max(0, Noclip.BrokenCount - 1)
            end
        end
    end
    if toRestore then
        for _, part in ipairs(toRestore) do
            RestorePart(part)
        end
    end
end

local AutoGive = { Running = false }

local MP5_ORIGIN_POS       = Vector3.new(813.698, 97.850, 2229.396)
local REMINGTON_ORIGIN_POS = Vector3.new(820.298, 97.850, 2229.396)
local MATCH_TOLERANCE      = 5

local TP_HEIGHT_OFFSET = 6
local TP_DWELL_TIME    = 0.8

local function FindTouchGiverByPos(targetPos)
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name == "TouchGiver" and obj:IsA("Model") then
            local ok, pos = pcall(function()
                local primary = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                return primary and primary.Position
            end)
            if ok and pos and (pos - targetPos).Magnitude < MATCH_TOLERANCE then
                return obj, pos
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function GetMyRoot()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function TeleportToTouchGiver(touchPos, myRoot, homeCFrame)
    if not myRoot or not touchPos then return end

    local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(touchPos + Vector3.new(0, TP_HEIGHT_OFFSET, 0))

    pcall(function()
        myRoot.CFrame = targetCFrame
    end)

    task.wait(TP_DWELL_TIME)

    pcall(function()
        myRoot.CFrame = homeCFrame
    end)

    task.wait(0.1)
end

local function SpawnTouchGiversInFront(force)
    if not force and not Flags["AutoGive/Enabled"] then return end
    if AutoGive.Running then return end
    AutoGive.Running = true

    task.wait(1.2)

    local myRoot = GetMyRoot()
    if not myRoot then
        AutoGive.Running = false
        return
    end

    local homeCFrame = myRoot.CFrame

    local _, mp5Pos = FindTouchGiverByPos(MP5_ORIGIN_POS)
    local _, remPos = FindTouchGiverByPos(REMINGTON_ORIGIN_POS)

    if not mp5Pos and not remPos then
        AutoGive.Running = false
        return
    end

    if remPos then
        TeleportToTouchGiver(remPos, myRoot, homeCFrame)
        myRoot = GetMyRoot()
        if myRoot then homeCFrame = myRoot.CFrame end
    end

    if mp5Pos then
        TeleportToTouchGiver(mp5Pos, myRoot, homeCFrame)
    end

    local finalRoot = GetMyRoot()
    if finalRoot then
        pcall(function() finalRoot.CFrame = homeCFrame end)
    end

    AutoGive.Running = false
end

local ArrestState = {
    Running = false,
    SelectedPlayer = nil,
    ChaserConn = nil,
    EndTime = 0,
    HomeCFrame = nil,
    TargetRoot = nil,
}

local function GetCriminalsList()
    local out = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(GetPlayersCache()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Parent then
            local role = DetectRole(p)
            if role == "Criminal" then
                local char, root = GetCharacter(p)
                if char and root then
                    local myRoot = GetMyRoot()
                    local dist = myRoot and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
                    table.insert(out, { player = p, dist = dist })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    return out
end

local function EquipToolByName(toolName)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if not char or not backpack then return false end

    local equipped = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if equipped and equipped.Name == toolName then return true end

    local tool = backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return false end

    pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end)
    return true
end

local function GetBehindCFrame(targetRoot)
    if not targetRoot then return nil end
    local dist = Flags["Arrest/StickDistance"] or 2.2
    local height = Flags["Arrest/StickHeight"] or 0.0
    return targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, height, dist)
end

local function StartChaser(targetRoot)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local myRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not myRoot or not hum then return nil end

    pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = false end)

    local chaserConn
    chaserConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local myR = LocalPlayer.Character
            and (LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or LocalPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart)
        if not myR then return end

        local behind = GetBehindCFrame(targetRoot)
        if behind then
            pcall(function()
                myR.CFrame = behind
                myR.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
        end
    end)

    return chaserConn
end

local function StopChaser(restoreCFrame)
    if ArrestState.ChaserConn then
        pcall(function() ArrestState.ChaserConn:Disconnect() end)
        ArrestState.ChaserConn = nil
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end)
    end

    local myRoot = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart)
    if myRoot and restoreCFrame then
        pcall(function() myRoot.CFrame = restoreCFrame end)
    end

    ArrestState.TargetRoot = nil
    ArrestState.HomeCFrame = nil
    ArrestState.EndTime = 0
end

local function ArrestPlayer(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Parent then return false end
    if ArrestState.Running then return false end

    ArrestState.Running = true

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and (myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or myChar.PrimaryPart)
    if not myRoot then
        ArrestState.Running = false
        return false
    end

    local homeCFrame = myRoot.CFrame

    local toolName = Flags["Arrest/ToolName"] or "Handcuffs"
    local equipped = EquipToolByName(toolName)
    if not equipped then
        Notify("Arrest", "Could not equip " .. toolName .. ". Make sure you're a Guard and have it in your backpack.")
        ArrestState.Running = false
        return false
    end

    task.wait(0.2)

    local targetChar, targetRoot = GetCharacter(targetPlayer)
    if not targetChar or not targetRoot then
        Notify("Arrest", "Target character not found.")
        pcall(function() myRoot.CFrame = homeCFrame end)
        ArrestState.Running = false
        return false
    end

    local behind = GetBehindCFrame(targetRoot)
    if behind then
        pcall(function() myRoot.CFrame = behind end)
        task.wait(0.1)
    end

    ArrestState.TargetRoot = targetRoot
    ArrestState.HomeCFrame = homeCFrame
    ArrestState.EndTime = tick() + (Flags["Arrest/StickDuration"] or 5.0)
    ArrestState.ChaserConn = StartChaser(targetRoot)

    task.spawn(function()
        while ArrestState.Running do
            task.wait(0.1)
            if tick() >= ArrestState.EndTime then
                if ArrestState.Running then
                    ArrestState.Running = false
                    StopChaser(homeCFrame)
                    Notify("Arrest", "Stick ended. You can click now or press the button again.")
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end)

    Notify("Arrest", string.format("Sticking to %s for %.1fs. Click on them to arrest!", targetPlayer.Name, Flags["Arrest/StickDuration"] or 5.0))
    return true
end

local function StopArrestStick()
    if not ArrestState.Running then return end
    ArrestState.Running = false
    StopChaser(ArrestState.HomeCFrame)
    Notify("Arrest", "Stopped sticking.")
end

local function TeleportToPosition(pos)
    if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then
        Notify("Teleport", "Invalid position.")
        return false
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then
        Notify("Teleport", "Character not found.")
        return false
    end

    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    if not root then
        Notify("Teleport", "HumanoidRootPart not found.")
        return false
    end

    -- Try a smarter teleport: offset upward if player would clip
    local offsetY = 3
    pcall(function()
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, offsetY, 0))
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)

    Notify("Teleport", string.format("Teleported to (%.0f, %.0f, %.0f)", pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z))
    return true
end

local function GetCurrentPosition()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return nil end
    return root.Position
end

        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = main.Position
    end

    main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            beginDrag(input)
        end
    end)
    sidebar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            beginDrag(input)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)

    local minimized = false
    local normalSize = main.Size

    State.ToggleMinimize = function()
        minimized = not minimized
        State.Minimized = minimized
        if minimized then
            normalSize = main.Size
            TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 34),
            }):Play()
            sidebar.Visible = false
            content.Visible = false
            closeBtn.Text = "+"
        else
            TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = normalSize,
            }):Play()
            task.wait(0.1)
            sidebar.Visible = true
            content.Visible = true
            closeBtn.Text = "–"
        end
    end

    closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(State.ToggleMinimize)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
        if gp then return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.CapsLock then
            State.ToggleMinimize()
        end
    end)

    return UI
end

function UI.CreateNumericInput(page, text, flag, default, minV, maxV, step, unit, callback, lockable)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = page
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); corner.Parent = frame

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.55, lockable and -42 or -12, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.FontFace = Font.fromName("Montserrat", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame

    if lockable then
        local locked = Flags[flag .. "/Locked"] == true
        local lockBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        lockBtn.Name = "Lock"
        lockBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
        lockBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        lockBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.6, -12, 0.5, 0)
        lockBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lockBtn.Text = locked and "🔒" or "🔓"
        lockBtn.FontFace = Font.fromName("Montserrat", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
        lockBtn.TextSize = 14
        lockBtn.TextColor3 = locked and THEME.Accent or THEME.TextDark
        lockBtn.Parent = frame

        State.Updaters[flag .. "/Locked"] = function(state)
            local l = state == true
            Flags[flag .. "/Locked"] = l
            SafeSet(lockBtn, "TextColor3", l and THEME.Accent or THEME.TextDark)
            SafeSet(lockBtn, "Text", l and "🔒" or "🔓")
        end

        lockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            Flags[flag .. "/Locked"] = not Flags[flag .. "/Locked"]
            local l = Flags[flag .. "/Locked"]
            SafeSet(lockBtn, "TextColor3", l and THEME.Accent or THEME.TextDark)
            SafeSet(lockBtn, "Text", l and "🔒" or "🔓")
        end)
    end

    local inputFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    inputFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -12, 0, 30)
    inputFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
    inputFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    inputFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
    inputFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    inputFrame.Parent = frame
    local ifCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ifCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); ifCorner.Parent = inputFrame

    if Flags[flag] == nil and not flag:match("^Humanoid/") then
        Flags[flag] = default
    end

    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 0)
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    box.Text = tostring(Flags[flag] ~= nil and Flags[flag] or default) .. (unit or "")
    box.FontFace = Font.fromName("Montserrat", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    box.TextSize = 12
    box.TextColor3 = THEME.Accent
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.Parent = inputFrame

    local function commit(val, isUser)
        val = math.clamp(tonumber(val) or (Flags[flag] or default), minV, maxV)
        if step and step > 0 then
            val = math.floor(val / step + 0.5) * step
        end
        Flags[flag] = val
        box.Text = tostring(val) .. (unit or "")
        if isUser then
            if callback then pcall(callback, val) end
        end
    end

    State.Updaters[flag] = function(val)
        if not box:IsFocused() then
            val = math.clamp(tonumber(val) or default, minV, maxV)
            box.Text = tostring(val) .. (unit or "")
            if callback then pcall(callback, val) end
        end
    end

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        commit((box.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")), true)
    end)

    local minus = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
    minus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    minus.Text = "−"
    minus.FontFace = Font.fromName("Montserrat", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    minus.TextSize = 16
    minus.TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark
    minus.Parent = inputFrame
    minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() commit((Flags[flag] or default) - (step or 1), true) end)

    local plus = Instance.new("TextButton")
    plus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
    plus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0)
    plus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    plus.Text = "+"
    plus.FontFace = Font.fromName("Montserrat", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    plus.TextSize = 16
    plus.TextColor3 = THEME.TextDark
    plus.Parent = inputFrame
    plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() commit((Flags[flag] or default) + (step or 1), true) end)
end

local function RefreshSavedList()
    for _, ch in ipairs(savedListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if not ch:IsA("UIListLayout") then ch:Destroy() end
    end

    local count = 0
    local sortedNames = {}
    for name, _ in pairs(SavedLocations) do
        table.insert(sortedNames, name)
    end
    table.sort(sortedNames)

    for i, name in ipairs(sortedNames) do
        local posTable = SavedLocations[name]
        count = count + 1

        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.LayoutOrder = i

        local rCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        rCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); rCorner.Parent = row

        local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 1, 0)
        nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
        nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLbl.Text = name
        nameLbl.FontFace = Font.fromName("Montserrat", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
        nameLbl.TextSize = 12

        goBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 26)
        goBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0.5, -13)
        goBtn.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Accent
        goBtn.Text = "GO"
        goBtn.FontFace = Font.fromName("Montserrat", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
        goBtn.TextSize = 11
        goBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 22)
        goBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        goBtn.Parent = row
        local gCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        gCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); gCorner.Parent = goBtn

        goBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local v3 = Vector3.new(posTable.X, posTable.Y, posTable.Z)
            TeleportToPosition(v3)
        end)

        local delBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        delBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
        delBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0.5, -13)
        delBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 30, 30)
        delBtn.Text = "✕"
        delBtn.FontFace = Font.fromName("Montserrat", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
        delBtn.TextSize = 13
        delBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 100, 100)
        delBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        delBtn.Parent = row
        local dCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        dCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); dCorner.Parent = delBtn

        delBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            SavedLocations[name] = nil
            SaveLocationsToDisk()
            RefreshSavedList()
            Notify("Teleport", "Deleted '" .. name .. "'")
        end)
    end

    if count == 0 then
        local emptyLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        emptyLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        emptyLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        emptyLbl.Text = "No saved locations yet."
